Based on the provided context, a GitLab team member can work remotely in a new location for a maximum total of **183 days** (approximately 6 months) per calendar year before it is considered a long-term relocation.

The text states: "Team members may live or work outside their permanent location... for a maximum total of 183 days (approximately 6 months) per calendar year." It also defines long-term relocation as spending "more than six months in one calendar year in one location."
